acceptedSamples.description: Dark application: logo and plus button above Home/Activities/Agents/Team/Settings. Home is blue selected, Activities has right chevron and is closed. Right main area retains search box and multiple grey placeholder bars/dividers; ordinary arrow below navigation.

Activities expands Tasks, Meetings and Calls, its chevron points down and lower root rows move downward. Home remains blue; Tasks has grey hover and hand cursor. Three child dots visible, no second nesting level.
Home still blue while hand cursor hovers Meetings in grey. A rounded vertical connector spans the Tasks and Meetings dots. This confirms initial Tasks/Meetings hovering is separate from selection.
Meetings is blue selected and Home neutral. Hand cursor hovers Calls in grey; vertical dot connector extends across all three child positions. Right content remains placeholder layout.
Calls is blue selected; hand cursor now hovers Tasks in grey. Connector trail is absent/faded at this frame, while all child dots and lower root rows remain.
Tasks is now blue selected. Hand cursor hovers Calls in grey; vertical connector spans the three child dots again. Main content does not show new business data.
Calls label/background is blue selected again. Blue bead is visibly settling toward Calls' dot while connector persists and hand stays over Calls.
Calls selected with its blue dot aligned and full grey connector. Activities is still expanded; all lower root entries remain shifted down.
Home returns to blue selection while Activities remains expanded. Hand cursor hovers Activities in grey, preparing the group-fold action. Child labels remain neutral.
Activities is closed again with right chevron. Agents/Team/Settings return upward; Home stays blue. Ordinary arrow below menu; main search and placeholder sections remain.
Tail remains closed and Home selected. Hand cursor hovers Activities in grey, with right chevron; no new expansion or business result at this frame.

mechanisms: One persistent dark application with left navigation and a large right content region; source main content contains search and grey placeholder sections throughout.
Activities is a one-level accordion containing Tasks, Meetings and Calls. Expand/collapse changes child clipping height, chevron direction and lower Agents/Team/Settings positions.
Root Home remains blue during initial child hovering. Initial Tasks hover is not treated as a verified Tasks selection.
Observed selected-state order is Home -> Meetings -> Calls -> Tasks -> Calls -> Home; hover hand and grey row backgrounds can differ from the currently blue selected row.

Blue rounded selection background, selected label color and blue child bead change together. Grey rounded connector between child dots is visible during hover/selection movement and fades in some frames.
Home can be selected while Activities remains expanded. Closing Activities then returns lower entries upward; tail includes another hover of the closed group.
Logo, plus action and right search area are retained visually. No plus action, search execution, actual file content or business page completion was shown.

Grey right-side placeholder sections remain visually present; they are not interpreted as a working loading pipeline, fetched records or generated results.

Sphere highlight travels through the right/lower hemisphere; left dot wave keeps flowing. Both initial captions remain.

Initial captions Making the first draft... / Forming the shapes... crossfade to Sketching it out... / Gathering the light...

Two circular retry glyphs appear and persist over the final matching images
